-- Zeigt die Buchungszeilen hinter den neuen Ueberbuchungen und prueft Freitextzahlen. Nur lesend.
WITH pos AS (
    SELECT
        p.booking_id,
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
        coalesce(p.quantity, 0) AS menge,
        coalesce(p.amount_net, 0) AS betrag,
        CASE
            WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '(bis zu|max\\.?|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}[0-9]+[[:space:]]*person'
            THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)(?:bis zu|max\\.?|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*person'))::int
        END AS basis_n,
        CASE
            WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '[0-9]+[[:space:]]*(personen|person|teiln\\.?|teilnehmer)'
            THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*(?:personen|person|teiln\\.?|teilnehmer)'))::int
        END AS text_n,
        (p.pricecategory_name ~* '(jede|je|pro)[[:space:]]+weitere|preis[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*für[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*jede[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*weitere') AS ist_zusatz
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT
        b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
        max(pos.basis_n) AS basis_n,
        max(pos.text_n) AS text_n,
        coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.ist_zusatz), 0) AS zusatz_n,
        coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.kat = 'Inklusive'), 0) AS inklusive_n,
        bool_or(pos.kat = 'Inklusive') AS hat_inklusive,
        string_agg(concat(left(pos.kat, 48), ' x', pos.menge, ' @', round(pos.betrag, 2)), ' + ' ORDER BY pos.betrag DESC, pos.kat) AS zeilen_text
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    JOIN pos ON pos.booking_id = b.booking_id
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, 4
),
regel_alt AS (
    SELECT j.*,
           CASE WHEN basis_n IS NOT NULL THEN basis_n + zusatz_n
                WHEN hat_inklusive THEN NULL ELSE 1 END AS plaetze_alt
    FROM je_buchung j
),
je_termin AS (
    SELECT o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'gebucht') AS buchungen,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'gebucht' AND r.plaetze_alt IS NULL) AS unklar,
           coalesce(sum(r.plaetze_alt) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'gebucht'), 0) AS plaetze_alt
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    JOIN regel_alt r ON r.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum
),
ueber AS (
    SELECT * FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND unklar = 0 AND plaetze_alt > user_maximum
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Buchung hinter Ueberbuchung' AS bereich,
           concat(to_char(u.date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' b', right(r.booking_id::text, 5)) AS kennzahl,
           coalesce(r.plaetze_alt, 0)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('termin ', left(u.name, 25), ' / basis ', coalesce(r.basis_n::text, '-'),
                  ' / zusatz ', r.zusatz_n, ' / inkl ', r.inklusive_n,
                  ' / ', left(r.zeilen_text, 180)) AS hinweis
    FROM ueber u
    JOIN regel_alt r ON r.offer_id = u.offer_id AND r.status = 'gebucht'

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Freitextregel unklar',
           CASE
               WHEN text_n IS NOT NULL THEN concat('textzahl ', text_n)
               WHEN hat_inklusive THEN concat('eins plus inklusive = ', 1 + inklusive_n + zusatz_n)
               ELSE 'nicht ableitbar'
           END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(netto), 2), ' / zusatzmenge ', sum(zusatz_n))
    FROM regel_alt
    WHERE status = 'gebucht' AND plaetze_alt IS NULL
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Freitextfall einzeln',
           concat('b', right(booking_id::text, 5)),
           coalesce(text_n, 1 + inklusive_n + zusatz_n)::numeric,
           concat('textzahl ', coalesce(text_n::text, '-'), ' / eins+inkl+zusatz ',
                  1 + inklusive_n + zusatz_n, ' / ', left(zeilen_text, 180))
    FROM regel_alt
    WHERE status = 'gebucht' AND plaetze_alt IS NULL

    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D offerdef Verteilung',
           CASE WHEN offerdef_ref IS NULL THEN '(leer)' ELSE left(offerdef_ref, 30) END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('von ', count(DISTINCT name), ' namen / ',
                  min(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD')), ' bis ', max(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD')))
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer
    WHERE is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY offerdef_ref
)
SELECT
    'S38' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
               chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;
